label: ivr
scenario: Classic DTMF utility phone tree: outage menu, account lookup by phone number, reads back affected area, restoration estimate and a reference number twice.
task: Report a power outage at the customer's home and get a reference number.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Thank you for calling Ridgeline Power and Light. For English, press 1. Para español, oprima el número 2.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: If you are calling to report a power outage, press 1. To pay your bill, press 2. For billing questions, press 3. To start, stop, or move service, press 4. For all other inquiries, press 0.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: If there is a downed power line or you smell gas, hang up and call 911. Please enter the ten-digit phone number associated with your account, followed by the pound sign.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: You entered 5 5 5, 0 1 9, 2 8 3 4. If this is correct, press 1. To re-enter, press 2.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: We have located an account at 88 Cobbler Lane. We are aware of an outage affecting your area. Approximately 1,240 customers are affected. The estimated restoration time is 6:30 PM. To add your address to this outage report, press 1.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Thank you. Your outage has been recorded. Your reference number is 4 7 7 1 9 0 3. Again, your reference number is 4 7 7 1 9 0 3. To receive text updates about this outage, press 1. Otherwise, you may hang up.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Text updates have been enabled for the number ending in 2 8 3 4. Thank you for calling Ridgeline Power and Light. Goodbye.
